intended_object: The canonical inclusion morphism ι : wideEqualizer f → X of the wide equalizer of a family of parallel morphisms f_j : X → Y, i.e. the limit projection at the object `zero` of the walking parallel family. Inferred from the docstring and name.
explanation: The wide equalizer of a family f : J → (X ⟶ Y) is the limit of the diagram `parallelFamily f`, which is indexed by the walking parallel family. That diagram sends the object `zero` to X. The definition takes the limit projection `limit.π (parallelFamily f) zero`, which is exactly the standard inclusion of the equalizer into X. The setting is fully general: any category, any index type J, and only the existence of the wide equalizer is assumed. This is the same pattern as Mathlib's `equalizer.ι`. The declaration is itself the Mathlib definition (it sits in Mathlib's own `WideEqualizers.lean`), so there is no other Mathlib counterpart to cite.
